stt.title: Speech-to-Text
stt.field_sync_timing: Synchronisieren Sie das Timing mit AI Transform
stt.deepgram_quality_notice: Einige Sprachen können nicht mit der Qualitätsoption „erweitert“ verwendet werden
stt.moonshine_desc: Führt Useful Sensors Moonshine in Docker oder einem anderen Prozess aus. Der Endpunkt muss POST /trancribe und GET /health verfügbar machen.
stt.moonshine_language_desc: z.B. de – muss mit den Erwartungen Ihres Moonshine-Servers übereinstimmen.
stt.openai_audio_desc: Für einen Server auf Ihrem Computer (z. B. Speaches, LocalAI), der POST /v1/audio/transcriptions implementiert. Audio bleibt lokal, es sei denn, Sie verweisen die URL auf einen Cloud-Host.
stt.openai_audio_language_desc: ISO-Code, wenn der Server ihn unterstützt; Lassen Sie das Feld leer, damit der Server entscheiden kann.
stt.whisper_use_local: Use local .bin file instead of download
stt.whisper_local_path: Path to GGML .bin on this PC
stt.whisper_local_hint: Import saves the file under app data so the next start skips the network. Or enable this option and set a path to copy from each time you start.
stt.vosk_local_path: Path to Vosk model .zip on this PC
stt.vosk_local_hint: Import saves the zip under app data for the selected catalog model. Or enable this option and set a path to copy from each time you start.
stt.rust_input_device_hint: Uses the desktop audio system's microphone names (cpal). Leave on System default to use Settings → Audio settings → Default input device.
stt.native_desktop_hint: Web Speech does not work in the desktop app. Use Whisper, Groq, Vosk, or the Chrome / Edge microphone page instead.
stt.status_whisper_dropped: Whisper is slower than real time and skipped {{seconds}} s of speech. Choose a smaller model or more CPU threads.
stt.status_rate_limited: Rate limit: next request in {{seconds}} s ({{count}} waiting, merged when sent)
stt.status_utterance_dropped: Some speech was skipped because transcription fell behind.
stt.error_requests_failed: {{engine}} stopped after {{attempts}} failed requests. Last error: {{detail}}
stt.error_rate_limit_wait: {{engine}} stopped: the rate limit asks to wait about {{minutes}} min (daily limit reached?). Try again later or switch provider.
stt.error_backlog: {{engine}} fell {{seconds}} s behind and was stopped. Try a faster server or model.
stt.error_groq_key_missing: Groq: enter your API key (free at console.groq.com/keys).
stt.error_http_base_url: Enter the base URL of your transcription server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
stt.error_http_base_url_invalid: "{{url}}" is not a valid URL. Use one such as http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
stt.error_http_model: Enter the model id your transcription server expects.
stt.error_moonshine_not_found: No Moonshine server answered at {{endpoint}}. Start it (for example with Docker, port 8090) and try again.
stt.error_deepgram_options: Deepgram: enter your API key and choose a language.
stt.error_azure_options: Azure: enter the key, the region and a language.
stt.error_native_options: Choose a language for Web Speech.
stt.error_native_unavailable: Web Speech is not available here. Use Whisper or Vosk in the desktop app.
stt.error_native_desktop: Web Speech does not work in the desktop app. Use Whisper, Groq, Vosk, or the Chrome / Edge microphone page instead.
stt.migrated_to_whisper: Speech-to-text now uses Whisper on this PC (Web Speech does not work in the desktop app). Press Start once to download the {{model}} model{{size}}.
stt.azure_segmentation_silence_desc: Silence that ends a phrase. Lower gives faster final captions; too low splits sentences. 100-5000, default 500.
stt.vad_desc: Silero VAD decides when you speak. Only speech is transcribed; silence and background noise never are.
stt.vad_threshold_desc: How sure the detector must be that you are speaking. Lower catches quiet speech, higher ignores more noise. Default 0.5.
stt.vad_min_silence_desc: A pause this long closes the sentence and sends it. Shorter feels faster but can split sentences. Default 500.
stt.vad_max_utterance_desc: Longer speech is split at the quietest moment. Default 18000.
stt.whisper_desc: Runs locally with whisper.cpp. The first start downloads the selected model once; your voice never leaves this PC.
stt.whisper_model_desc: Bigger models are more accurate but slower on the CPU. Q5 / Q8 builds are smaller and faster with almost the same accuracy. English-only models are a little better for English.
stt.whisper_anime_hint: Anime-Whisper is a Japanese model for expressive speech. It is not downloaded: convert litagin/anime-whisper to a ggml .bin with whisper.cpp, then use it as a local model file below.
stt.whisper_language_desc: Setting your language is faster and more accurate than detection. English-only models always transcribe English.
stt.whisper_hallucination_filter_desc: Drops phantom phrases such as "Thanks for watching" when they make up a whole sentence, and collapses repeated loops.
stt.whisper_no_speech_threshold_desc: Drops a sentence when Whisper thinks it is not speech with more than this confidence. 1 turns it off. Default 0.6.
stt.whisper_hotwords_desc: Comma-separated names and terms Whisper should spell correctly.
stt.whisper_initial_prompt_desc: Optional text that sets the style and topic, for example "Casual chat in VRChat."
stt.whisper_threads_desc: Automatic uses about half your cores (at most 4) so games keep their CPU time.
stt.whisper_max_backlog_desc: Sentences that may wait for the model. If Whisper falls further behind, the oldest waiting sentence is skipped so captions stay current. Default 3.
stt.groq_desc: Whisper large-v3 Turbo on Groq's free plan: very accurate and fast. Needs an internet connection and a free API key; your speech is sent to Groq.
stt.openai_audio_prompt_desc: Names and terms to spell correctly, or a sentence that sets the style.
stt.vosk_desc: Runs locally. The model downloads once as a zip into app data, then loads offline.
stt.vosk_model_desc: Models are downloaded once and kept. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
stt.vosk_model_url_desc: Full URL of a Vosk model .zip. It replaces the catalog URL for the download; the file is still saved under app data as the selected model.
stt.shortcut_desc: Global shortcuts also work while Sigil is in the background, for example in VRChat.
stt.shortcut_hint_unsupported: That key cannot be used for a global shortcut.
stt.shortcut_hint_in_use: Another Sigil shortcut already uses this combination.
stt.shortcut_hint_needs_ctrl_alt: Add Ctrl, Alt or Win (Shift alone is not enough), or use an F-key, so the shortcut does not block normal typing.
stt.groq_limits_merge: Groq bills every request as at least 10 seconds. If you talk a lot, Sigil sends short sentences together (captions can then arrive a few seconds later), so the daily limit lasts a long stream.
stt.route_note_auto_language: The spoken language is detected for every sentence.
stt.route_note_language_id: A small language detector listens to each sentence before it is transcribed.
stt.route_note_generic_language_model: No model is made for this language, so a general multilingual model transcribes it.
stt.route_note_finals_only: Captions appear when you finish a sentence, without live partial captions.
stt.route_note_single_pass: Two-pass captions are off, so each sentence is transcribed once.
stt.route_note_few_cores_single_pass: This PC has too few processor cores to run two speech models at once, so each sentence is transcribed once.
stt.route_note_vc_running_single_pass: The voice changer is using the processor, so each sentence is transcribed once.
stt.route_note_gpu_unavailable: The graphics card cannot be used for speech recognition here, so it runs on the processor.
stt.route_note_gpu_runtime_unavailable: The GPU speech runtime is not installed, so speech recognition runs on the processor. Import it in Models & Runtimes to use the graphics card.
stt.route_note_gpu_denied_vc_running: The voice changer is using the graphics card, so captions run on the processor. Choose the GPU tier to share the card anyway.
stt.route_note_vc_shares_gpu: Captions and the voice changer share the graphics card.
stt.route_note_gpu_full: Too little video memory is free for a GPU model right now, so it runs on the processor.
stt.route_note_no_gpu_model_for_language: No GPU model is better than the processor model for this language.
stt.route_note_nemotron_needs_language: Live partial captions need to know the language: pick one to turn them on.
stt.route_note_never_route: A model was skipped because it does not handle this language well.
stt.route_note_no_engine: No speech model is available for this language.
stt.route_note_routing_table_invalid: The speech model table could not be read (see the log).
stt.local_desc: Sigil picks the best speech models for your language and your PC and runs them here. Models download once, only after you agree; your voice never leaves this PC.
stt.local_language_desc: Choosing the language you speak gives live captions and the most accurate model. Detection works sentence by sentence, with captions after each sentence.
stt.local_tier_desc: Best for my PC uses the graphics card when it has room and a better model for your language, and leaves it to the voice changer when the card is small.
stt.local_two_pass_desc: Shows live captions while you speak, then replaces each sentence with a more accurate transcription. Needs a larger download and more computing power; Sigil uses one pass when this PC cannot afford two.
stt.local_smart_turn: Detect when you finish speaking (Smart Turn)
stt.local_smart_turn_desc: Lets translation, text-to-speech and the VRChat chatbox send sooner when you have finished your turn. Captions are not affected. Adds a 9 MB download.
stt.local_hotwords_desc: Comma-separated names and terms to recognize reliably, such as your friends' names. Used by the models that support it.
stt.local_route_error: Could not check the speech models: {{error}}
stt.local_route_desktop_only: Speech recognition on this PC needs the desktop app.
stt.local_route_summary_two_pass: Live captions while you speak, then a more accurate final text for each sentence.
stt.local_route_none: No speech model is available for this language on this PC.
stt.local_role_fallback: Backup if the graphics card fails
stt.local_consent_smaller_hint: Or choose the smaller setup ({{size}}): live captions with one pass, slightly less accurate.
stt.local_consent_smaller_hint_free: Or skip the second, more accurate pass: it needs no download, and captions stay live.
stt.local_consent_smaller_hint_finals: Or choose the smaller setup ({{size}}): one model, with captions after each sentence instead of live captions.
stt.local_consent_smaller_hint_finals_free: Or skip live captions: that needs no download, and captions appear after each sentence.
stt.local_status_checking: Checking which speech models this PC needs…
stt.local_status_consent: Waiting for your answer about the model download…
stt.local_status_capture_gap: The microphone stream was interrupted and is recovering.
stt.local_status_engine_fallback: Switched to a backup speech model: {{detail}}
stt.local_status_not_installed: {{model}} is not installed, so it is skipped.
stt.local_status_restarting: Speech recognition stopped ({{detail}}). Restarting in {{seconds}} s…
stt.local_error_desktop_only: Speech recognition on this PC needs the desktop app.
stt.local_error_no_engine: No speech model is available for this language on this PC. Choose another language, or detection.
stt.local_error_not_installed: {{model}} is missing. Download it in the Speech-to-text panel or in Models & Runtimes.
stt.local_error_gave_up: Speech recognition stopped after {{attempts}} failed restarts. Last error: {{detail}}
stt.local_error_stopped_elsewhere: Speech recognition was stopped because another part of Sigil started it again.
stt.local_error_declined: Speech recognition needs the model download. Press Start again when you are ready, or download the models in the Speech-to-text panel.
stt.local_error_models_missing: The speech models ({{size}}) are not downloaded yet. Open Speech-to-text and press Start to download them.
stt.local_error_catalog: The list of speech models could not be loaded: {{error}}
stt.local_error_unknown_models: This version of Sigil does not know the speech model(s) {{ids}}. Update Sigil or choose another language.
stt.local_error_import_needed: {{list}} cannot be downloaded: import it in Models & Runtimes.
stt.local_error_download_cancelled: The speech model download was cancelled.
stt.local_log_started: Speech recognition on this PC started: {{models}}
stt.local_log_restarted: Speech recognition on this PC restarted after an error.
stt.local_log_smaller_setup: Two-pass accuracy was turned off to use the smaller download.
stt.local_log_two_pass_suspended: The accurate second pass is not keeping up; captions are sent after the first pass until it does.
stt.local_log_two_pass_resumed: The accurate second pass is back.
stt.local_offer_message: Sigil can now pick the best speech models for your language and your PC and run them here, with live captions. Switch speech-to-text to "On this PC (automatic)"? Nothing downloads until you press Start and agree.
stt.moonshine_legacy_notice: Legacy: this backend sends your speech to a Moonshine server that you run yourself, for example in Docker. The Local backend runs Moonshine and other speech models inside Sigil, with nothing else to install.
stt.openai_audio_lan_hint: Sigil sends the requests itself, so a server elsewhere on your network works too, for example http://192.168.1.20:8000/v1.
stt.browser_keep_open: The page runs speech recognition in {{browser}} and sends the text to Sigil. Keep it open while speech-to-text runs.
stt.status_external_waiting: Waiting for the microphone page in {{browser}}. Open it with the button in the Speech-to-Text settings.
stt.status_request_limit_wait: Request limit reached: the next request waits about {{seconds}} s. Sentences said meanwhile are sent together.
stt.status_capture_gap: The microphone stream was interrupted, so a little speech may be missing.
stt.status_dropped_rate_limited: Some speech was skipped because the request limit was reached.
stt.status_dropped_request_failed: Some speech was skipped because a request failed.
stt.error_moonshine_start: Moonshine could not start with the server at {{endpoint}} ({{detail}}). Start the server (for example with Docker, port 8090) and try again, or use the Local backend.
stt.error_mic_denied: Microphone permission denied or unavailable. Allow the microphone for Sigil or pick another input device.
stt.error_mic_missing: The selected microphone was not found. Pick another input device.
stt.error_deepgram_start: Deepgram could not start ({{detail}}). Check the API key and the audio settings.
stt.error_deepgram_connect: Could not connect to Deepgram. Check the API key and your internet connection.
stt.error_deepgram_lost: The connection to Deepgram was lost ({{detail}}).
stt.error_azure_sdk: The Azure Speech component could not be loaded: {{detail}}
stt.error_azure_auth: Azure rejected the key or the region. Check both in the Azure settings.
stt.error_azure_connection: Could not connect to Azure Speech. Check your internet connection and the region.
stt.error_azure_quota: Azure Speech refused more requests (quota or rate limit). Try again later.
stt.error_native_network: Web Speech lost its connection to the speech service.
stt.error_native_not_allowed: Web Speech is not allowed to use the microphone or the speech service. Allow microphone access and try again.
stt.error_native_mic: Web Speech found no working microphone.
stt.error_native_language: Web Speech does not support the language {{language}}.
stt.local_onboarding_desc: Recommended. Sigil picks the best speech models for your language and your PC; they download once, after you agree.
stt.local_status_language_auto: The live model is guessing the spoken language. Choose your language for more accurate live captions.
stt.local_status_hotwords_unavailable: This model cannot use hotwords; recognition continues without them.
stt.route_note_vc_unknown_single_pass: The voice changer is starting and may use the processor, so each sentence is transcribed once. Restart captions after it has started to get two-pass captions.
stt.route_note_no_cpu_fallback: If the graphics card fails, captions keep the live text instead of transcribing again on the processor, which has too few cores or is running the voice changer.
stt.groq_limits_paced: The free plan allows 20 requests per minute, 2,000 per day and 2 hours of audio per hour. Sigil sends one request per sentence and paces them to stay inside these limits. Sentences that have to wait are sent together; speech that would wait more than 2 minutes is skipped, and the status line says so.

tts.title: Text-to-Speech
tts.neural_sidecar_desc: You run a program that answers GET /health and POST /speech with JSON { text, voice }. Example: scripts/neural-sidecar/tts_sidecar.py (port 8766). See that folder’s README.
tts.ep_cuda_plain: NVIDIA GPU / CUDA (needs NVIDIA drivers and CUDA runtime)
tts.neural_onnx_browse_unavailable: Folder browse is available in the desktop app.
tts.http_list_fetch_failed: Could not load voices from the server. Check the URL and that the service is running.
tts.kokoro_desc: Kokoro FastAPI–compatible server (OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech). Example: docker run -p 8880:8880 ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu
tts.melo_desc: MeloTTS HTTP API. Example: docker run -p 8888:8888 myshell-ai/melotts
tts.chatterbox_desc: Chatterbox TTS HTTP server (see your stack’s compose or docs). Default URL is often port 5555.
tts.fish_desc: Fish Speech API. Example: docker run -p 8080:8080 fishaudio/fish-speech
tts.uberduck_voice_desc_key: Voices load once a valid API key is entered.
tts.native_unavailable: Speech synthesis is not available in this webview.
tts.native_voice_missing: The selected voice is not installed on this PC. Choose another voice.
tts.fish_hosted_hint: Fish Audio's hosted API: set the server URL to https://api.fish.audio, enter your API key, and pick a model such as s2.1-pro-free. A self-hosted server needs a key only if it was started with --api-key.
tts.voicevox_desc: Japanese character voices from a VOICEVOX-compatible engine (VOICEVOX or AivisSpeech) running on this PC. Download:
tts.voicevox_aivis_hint: AivisSpeech voices sound best at pitch 0. Intonation sets how strongly the style's emotion comes through.
tts.voicevox_no_speakers: No speakers found. Is the engine running?
tts.voicevox_host_error_empty: Enter the engine URL, for example http://localhost:50021.
tts.voicevox_host_error_invalid_url: "{{host}}" is not a valid engine URL. Use a URL such as http://localhost:50021.
tts.voicevox_host_error_remote_http: Sigil can reach {{host}} only over https. Plain http works only for engines on this PC (localhost or 127.0.0.1).
tts.voicevox_not_running: No VOICEVOX-compatible engine answered at {{host}}. Start VOICEVOX or AivisSpeech (or check the URL), then try again.
tts.voicevox_timeout: The engine at {{host}} did not answer in time.
tts.voicevox_not_responding: The engine at {{host}} answered with HTTP {{status}}.
tts.azure_connect_failed: Could not connect with this key and region ("{{region}}"). Check both, and your internet connection. Details: {{error}}
tts.azure_connect_timeout: The speech service for region "{{region}}" did not answer in time. Check the region and your internet connection.
tts.route_vc_hint: Speech is mixed into your microphone before conversion, so it comes out in your converted voice. What happens to your microphone meanwhile is set in the voice changer (Microphone while TTS plays).
tts.route_vc_not_running: The voice changer is not running: speech plays on the output device until you start it.
tts.route_self_playing: This voice plays by itself on its own output, so it is spoken as a whole and cannot go through the voice changer.
tts.local_neural_desc: Natural voices that run on this PC's processor: Kokoro (English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese), Kitten (English) and Piper voices for many more languages. No server to run; each voice downloads once.
tts.local_neural_desktop_only: Local voices work in the desktop app.
tts.local_neural_list_failed: The list of local voices could not be read.
tts.local_neural_folder_hint: An official sherpa-onnx Kokoro, Kitten or Piper voice folder, or a Sigil speech package (config.json with its model and voices).
tts.local_neural_not_downloaded: {{title}} is not downloaded yet. Download it in the voice panel or in Models & Runtimes.
tts.neural_onnx_desc_local_engine: Runs Kitten voices on this PC's processor, from a Hugging Face repo or a speech package folder. Speech plays through the selected output device and can go into the voice changer (Routing below).
tts.neural_onnx_prefer_local_neural: More voices and languages (Kokoro, Piper) are in the local voice backend.
tts.neural_onnx_hub_invalid: "{{repo}}" is not a valid Hugging Face repo id (org/name).
tts.neural_onnx_hub_catalog_reason: This Kitten model downloads as Sigil's verified package (a copy downloaded by an earlier Sigil version also keeps working):
tts.neural_onnx_hub_download_note: The model downloads from Hugging Face the first time the voice starts.
tts.neural_onnx_local_hint_v2: A speech package folder (config.json plus the model and voice files it names), or an official sherpa-onnx Kokoro, Kitten or Piper voice folder.
tts.local_neural_ja_note: Japanese: kana are read well, but kanji may get Chinese readings. For natural Japanese, VOICEVOX or AivisSpeech sound better.
tts.openai_speech_desc: Any server that speaks the OpenAI text-to-speech API (/v1/audio/speech): Kokoro-FastAPI, Chatterbox, Voxtral, IndexTTS or VoxCPM2 on vLLM, Qwen3-TTS (qwentts.cpp), and others. Audio streams as it is generated, so speech starts before the sentence is finished.
tts.openai_speech_voices_loaded: {{n}} voices on this server. Type to filter.
tts.openai_speech_no_voices: This server does not list its voices. Type the voice id.
tts.openai_speech_test_text: Hello! This is how my voice sounds.
tts.openai_speech_extra_hint: Server-specific options merged into every request, for example {"lang_code": "j"} for Kokoro-FastAPI or {"exaggeration": 0.7} for Chatterbox.
tts.openai_speech_extra_invalid: Extra request fields must be a JSON object, for example {"lang_code": "a"}.
tts.openai_speech_url_missing: Enter the server URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1.
tts.openai_speech_unreachable: No speech server answered at {{url}}. Start it (or check the URL), then try again.
tts.http_legacy_openai_hint: Speech streams through the OpenAI-compatible client. For Voxtral, IndexTTS, VoxCPM2 or Qwen3-TTS servers, choose "OpenAI-compatible (HTTP)".
tts.local_offer_message: Sigil can now speak with Kokoro, a natural voice that runs on this PC (English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Portuguese, plus Piper voices for many more languages). Switch text-to-speech to "Kokoro / Piper (local)"? The voice (about 360 MB) downloads only after you agree in its panel.
tts.local_offer_switched: Text-to-speech now uses "Kokoro / Piper (local)". Download the voice in its panel to start speaking.
tts.openai_speech_timeout_hint: How long the server may take before the first audio of a sentence (up to 600 s; automatic gives servers on this PC or the LAN more time for long sentences). Once audio plays, a pause longer than 110 s ends the sentence.

transl.title: Übersetzung
transl.libretranslate_desc: Self-hosted LibreTranslate or any server with the same API (GET /languages, POST /translate, POST /detect). See scripts/translation-sidecar/README.md.
transl.ondevice_desc: Uses the experimental built-in Translator API when your WebView exposes it (recent Edge/Chrome-style runtimes). Often unavailable in stable WebView2; use LibreTranslate or Azure if this fails.
transl.azure_location_hint: Needed only for regional or multi-service Azure resources. Leave it empty for a global Translator resource.
transl.azure_error_key_missing: Enter your Azure Translator key first.
transl.azure_error_auth: Azure Translator rejected the request (HTTP {{status}}): {{error}}. Check the key, and set Region if your resource is not global.
transl.azure_error_response: Azure Translator sent a response Sigil could not read.
transl.error_line_failed: A line could not be translated: {{error}}
transl.libretranslate_error_endpoint_missing: Enter the LibreTranslate server URL first.
transl.libretranslate_error_unavailable: No LibreTranslate server answered at {{endpoint}}. Make sure it is running.
transl.ondevice_error_unavailable: On-device translation is not available in this WebView. It needs the built-in Translator API (recent Edge or Chrome runtimes); use LibreTranslate or Azure instead.
transl.ondevice_error_start: The on-device translator could not start (the model download failed or the language pair is not supported): {{error}}
transl.error_start_no_details: Translation could not start, and the provider gave no reason. Check the provider settings and try again.
transl.llm_server_desc: Sigil runs this translation model on your PC with llama.cpp. Your text never leaves the computer.
transl.llm_server_group_specialists: Specialists (for one language pair or style)
transl.llm_server_model_custom: A GGUF file on this PC…
transl.llm_server_pick_file: Choose a .gguf file to see whether it fits on this PC.
transl.llm_server_models_error: Could not read the model list: {{message}}
transl.llm_server_plan_loading: Checking what fits on this PC…
transl.llm_server_plan_gpu: {{variant}}, {{layers}}: about {{need}} of the {{free}} of video memory Sigil can use
transl.llm_server_reason_fits: It fits next to everything else that uses the graphics card.
transl.llm_server_reason_vc_running: The voice changer is using the graphics card, and this model would leave too little for it. Choose a smaller model, run it on the processor, or stop the voice changer first.
transl.llm_server_reason_shared_gpu: Other models Sigil has loaded leave {{free}} of video memory, and this model needs {{need}}.
transl.llm_server_reason_small_gpu: This graphics card is too small for this model (it needs {{need}}).
transl.llm_server_reason_gpu_full: Only {{free}} of video memory is free for it, and it needs {{need}}.
transl.llm_server_reason_no_gpu: No graphics card was found, so it runs on the processor.
transl.llm_server_reason_integrated_gpu: The graphics card is built into the processor, so the model runs on the processor.
transl.llm_server_reason_gpu_unknown: The graphics card could not be checked, so it runs on the processor for now.
transl.llm_server_reason_no_gpu_runtime: The CUDA version needs an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 16 / RTX 20 series or newer card with driver 580 or newer. Choose the Vulkan version instead.
transl.llm_server_reason_low_memory: This PC does not have enough memory to run this model on the processor.
transl.llm_server_reason_needs_runtime_update: The llama.cpp version included with Sigil cannot run this model yet.
transl.llm_server_reason_cpu_selected: It runs on the processor, as chosen.
transl.llm_server_reason_user_layers: It uses the number of graphics card layers you set.
transl.llm_server_override_hint: The game or the voice changer may stutter.
transl.llm_server_override_on: It will start anyway until Sigil closes.

transl.partials_local_agreement_hint: Shows only the words two partial translations in a row agree on, so captions grow without flickering. The full translation follows when you finish the sentence.
transl.partials_show_tentative_hint: Captions also show the newest words before they are confirmed; they may still change.
transl.partials_throttle_hint: Fewer partial requests save CPU, video memory and cloud quota; the newest partial always wins.
transl.partials_turn_end_hint: When Smart Turn says a sentence is not finished, it is joined with the next one and translated as one line.

transl.input_field_hint: Also translates what you type in the text field.

transl.route_desc: For every line, Sigil tries the engines in order and moves on to the next one when an engine is not set up, cannot translate the pair, fails or takes too long. Set up each engine by choosing it as the provider once.
transl.route_chain_hint: The first engine that can translate the line wins.
transl.route_rules_hint: Use another engine order for some language pairs, for example a Japanese specialist for Japanese to English. The first matching rule wins.
transl.route_interim_hint: Partial captions change several times per sentence, so a fast engine keeps them up to date; the full translation still uses the order above.
transl.route_timeout_hint: After this long without an answer, the next engine is tried.
transl.route_cloud_fallback_hint: When an online engine fails, also try Firefox Translations and NLLB if they are not in the order.

transform.title: KI-Transformation
transform.system_prompt_placeholder: Example: Rewrite the input text to be more professional, correcting any grammar mistakes.
transform.tokens_reasoning_hint: Thinking models spend part of the token limit on reasoning, so a low limit can leave no room for the reply. Lower effort answers faster. Not every model accepts every level: keep "Model default" if the provider reports an error.
transform.live_settings_hint: Key, URL, model, prompt and limits apply from the next sentence; no restart needed.
transform.context_history_hint: ✱ Sends your previous sentences to the AI for better context. Uses slightly more tokens.

transform.error_timeout: AI Transform got no reply within {{seconds}} s, so the original text was sent instead.
transform.error_rate_limited: The AI provider is rate limiting requests, so the original text is sent until it recovers.
transform.error_truncated: The AI reply hit the max output tokens limit before producing any text, so the original text was sent. Raise "Max output tokens" or lower the reasoning effort.
transform.error_empty: The AI returned no text, so the original text was sent instead.
transform.error_request: AI Transform request failed (HTTP {{status}}): {{error}}. The original text was sent instead.
transform.field_fence_input: Treat speech as text to rewrite
transform.fence_input_hint: Recommended. Each line is sent inside <text> tags with a note that it is text to rewrite, so the AI does not answer spoken questions or follow instructions someone says. Turn this off only if your prompt should make the AI reply to what you say.

obs.title: OBS Studio
obs.quick_start: Kopieren Sie die Browser-Quell-URL und fügen Sie sie in eine OBS-Browser-Quelle ein. Es spiegelt Ihre Sigil-Leinwand wider (lassen Sie die Desktop-App laufen). Die folgenden optionalen Einstellungen für das Erscheinungsbild von Untertiteln gelten nur für die eigenständige Untertitelseite, nicht für diese URL. Native Stream-Untertitel (reduzierbar) verwenden obs-websocket.
obs.field_browser_max_lines: Maximale Anzahl an Zeilen für die Beschriftung
obs.clarify_two_paths: Zwei verschiedene Funktionen: Die Browser-URL spiegelt Ihre Sigil-Leinwand in OBS wider (unabhängig davon, welchen Text/welche Bilder Sie in die Szene einfügen). Dies unterscheidet sich von „Native Stream-Untertitel“ unten, die obs-websocket verwenden und keine Browser-URL benötigen.
obs.checklist_browser_mirror: Kurze Checkliste: • Sigil Desktop läuft auf diesem PC. • Browser-Quell-URL stimmt mit Curses: http://localhost:PORT/client überein (verwenden Sie den in Sigil angezeigten Port; durch Kopieren in der Registerkarte „OBS“ wird dies ausgefüllt). • Die aktive Szene verfügt über mindestens ein Textelement; Legen Sie die Textquelle fest (z. B. Speech-to-Text). • Deaktivieren Sie in OBS „Quelle herunterfahren, wenn nicht sichtbar“, wenn Updates einfrieren, wenn die Quelle ausgeblendet ist.
obs.native_captions_explain: Wenn WebSocket verbunden ist, senden native Stream-Untertitel Ihre ausgewählte Textquelle über SendStreamCaption (im Stream eingebettete Untertitel) an OBS. Für diesen Pfad ist keine Browserquelle erforderlich.
obs.browser_source_desc: Erstellen Sie eine neue Browserquelle, fügen Sie den Link ein und stellen Sie die Fenstergröße auf {{width}}x{{height}} Pixel ein
obs.browser_source_tips: OBS verwendet einen eingebetteten Browser (CEF), nicht Ihr installiertes Chrome. Wenn die URL in Chrome/Edge, aber nicht in OBS funktioniert, aktualisieren Sie OBS, aktivieren Sie Einstellungen → Erweitert → „Hardwarebeschleunigung der Browserquelle aktivieren“ und klicken Sie dann mit der rechten Maustaste auf die Browserquelle → Aktualisieren. Der lokale Server folgt dem ursprünglichen Curses-Setup: Verwenden Sie http://localhost:PORT/client (dasselbe wie Curses‘ localhost:3030/client mit Ihrem Port). Lassen Sie Sigil während des Streamings laufen. Fügen Sie auf der Leinwand ein Textelement für die aktive Szene hinzu, wenn Sie sichtbare Untertitel erwarten. Deaktivieren Sie in OBS „Quelle herunterfahren, wenn nicht sichtbar“, wenn die Quelle einfriert, wenn sie ausgeblendet ist.

twitch.desc_emotes_remap_vs_chat: Remap emotes (dictionary above) only adds emote images to captions and canvas overlays—it does not change the text sent to Twitch chat. To say a word and have chat show an emote (e.g. hype → Kappa), use Speech-to-Text → Edit word replacements: set the spoken word as the key and the exact Twitch emote code as the value, enable Ignore letter case if needed, set Post in chat's text source to Speech-to-Text, and keep Post in chat enabled.
twitch.field_enable_captions_emotes_desc: When on, spoken words that match the remap dictionary can show as emote images in Sigil captions/overlays. This is separate from the characters sent to Twitch IRC.

twitch.field_apply_emote_remap_to_chat_desc: When posting to Twitch chat, replace whole words with their remapped emote code if that code is in your loaded emote list. Runs after Speech-to-Text word replacements. Off by default so behavior stays predictable.

voice_changer.vram_note: Voice conversion can use a lot of GPU time alongside VRChat or OBS. Prefer a WebSocket server on another PC or GPU, or use built-in mode to save resources. See scripts/neural-sidecar/README.md.
voice_changer.title: Voice changer
voice_changer.sidecar_ws_hint: Use ws:// or wss:// (for example ws://127.0.0.1:8765). Run your converter server first; see scripts/neural-sidecar/README.md.
voice_changer.sidecar_pitch_note: Your WebSocket server supplies the main conversion; Pitch and the other Sound sliders still process audio after it returns.
voice_changer.sidecar_postprocess_divider: After WebSocket or ONNX (pitch, brightness, smoothing)
voice_changer.onnx_model_hint: Float32 in/out; choose a .onnx file. Use the repo identity model to test the path. Sigil adjusts chunk shape when it does not match your mic.
voice_changer.oversampling_hint: More steps per analysis window usually means smoother pitch and higher CPU. Use 1 or 2 if the voice changer stutters.
voice_changer.tips_body: Start turns processing on; Stop turns it off. Pitch always uses the phase vocoder (built-in on the mic, or on WebSocket/ONNX output). Brightness adjusts high/low balance, not full formant modeling. Window length and oversampling trade CPU for quality; if it stutters, shorten the window or try oversampling 1, 2, or 4. Changing chunk size, buffer ms, output devices, or monitor device while running restarts the voice changer. Echo cancellation and noise suppression are not built in—use your OS, mic software, or OBS filters if needed.
voice_changer.onnx_postprocess_note: The ONNX model runs first; Pitch, brightness, and phase-vocoder settings then refine the output.
voice_changer.onnx_browse_unavailable: File browse is available in the desktop app.
voice_changer.chunk_hint: Larger chunks add delay but can stabilize conversion; ONNX models need a compatible fixed shape—Sigil adapts when possible. Changing chunk restarts processing.
voice_changer.buffer_truncate_hint: When the queued tail is consistently quiet, drop backlog toward the minimum prefill to reduce delay (similar to VCClient worklet truncation).
voice_changer.quick_presets_hint: One-tap character presets; use the controls above for fine tuning.
voice_changer.monitor_hint: Send processed audio to a second output (e.g. headphones) while the main output goes to a virtual cable for VRChat or OBS. Uses the same buffer settings as the main output; gain is independent of main output gain.
voice_changer.sidecar_ws_info:
Use ws:// or wss:// (for example ws://127.0.0.1:8765). Start your converter before Sigil; see scripts/neural-sidecar/README.md.

Your server supplies the main conversion; the Sound section can still shift pitch, brightness, and smoothing on the returned audio.
voice_changer.section_how_it_works_info: Pick built-in processing, a WebSocket converter, a local ONNX file, or RVC (bring-your-own ONNX slot). WebSocket, ONNX, and RVC handle the main voice change; the Sound section can still adjust pitch, brightness, and smoothing on the result.
voice_changer.section_timing_buffer_info: Low latency vs Stable only changes the playback cushion (prefill / max queue). Chunk size and exact millisecond values live under Advanced. This is separate from the RVC Quality profile.
voice_changer.section_sound_info: Pitch and brightness apply in every mode. In Built-in they are the main effect; in RVC / ONNX / WebSocket they refine the converted audio.
voice_changer.section_devices_info: Main output is what viewers or VRChat hear. Monitor is an optional second output (for example headphones) while the main device stays on a virtual cable.
voice_changer.section_advanced_info: Chunk size, exact buffer milliseconds, and silence trim. Prefer Playback feel above unless you need custom values.
voice_changer.onnx_files_info:
Float32 in/out; pick a .onnx file. Use the repo identity model to test the path. Sigil adjusts chunk shape when it does not match your mic.

The model does the main conversion; Pitch and the other Sound controls still run afterward on its output.
voice_changer.onnx_ep_help: Registers ONNX Runtime execution providers for the voice model in order (GPU then CPU fallback). CPU is the most compatible. CUDA requires NVIDIA drivers; DirectML is Windows-only. Does not affect mic or speaker routing.
voice_changer.wip_banner_body: Voice changer is still evolving — settings hot-swap when possible; some changes restart the engine.
voice_changer.toast_error_onnx: Voice changer (ONNX): conversion failed; that audio was muted. {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_sidecar: Voice changer (WebSocket): conversion failed; that audio was muted. {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_sidecar_length: Voice changer (WebSocket): wrong chunk size; using dry input. {{message}}
voice_changer.hot_swap_note: Changing mode, devices, chunk size, or model path reconnects the audio pipeline in place (no app restart). Timing buffer sliders apply while running.
voice_changer.rvc_quality_banner: Quality uses more GPU/VRAM and can contend with OBS and games. Prefer Streamer while streaming, or encode with NVENC so the game GPU stays free for RVC.
voice_changer.vram_cap_cuda_only: Only applies when the execution provider is CUDA. The cap is per ONNX session (HuBERT, generator and pitch extractor each get it), so total VRAM use can reach about three times the cap.
voice_changer.debug_captured: Debug snapshot written to the developer console.
voice_changer.section_rvc_bases_info: Optional if files live under AppData/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/base/ (hubert_base.onnx, fcpe.onnx, rmvpe.onnx). Empty paths auto-resolve from that folder or the slot.
voice_changer.section_rvc_tuning_info: Extra context and crossfade trade latency for stability; the engine restarts when you release the slider or leave the field. Crossfade cannot be longer than one processing chunk, so its maximum follows the chunk size (about 10 ms at 512 samples). Index rate blends in the slot's FAISS .index file (standard RVC IVF-Flat exports load); 0 turns it off. Protect keeps breaths and voiceless consonants clear (lower is stronger; 0.5 turns it off).
voice_changer.section_rvc_expert_info: RVC has its own execution provider, separate from ONNX mode; GPU providers fall back to CPU. CUDA requires NVIDIA drivers; DirectML is Windows-only. GPU device index picks the CUDA or DirectML adapter (0 = first GPU). VRAM cap limits CUDA memory only, per ONNX session (HuBERT, generator and pitch extractor). Speaker ID selects the voice in multi-speaker models. Does not affect mic or speaker routing.
voice_changer.section_tone_vocoder_info: Analysis window and oversampling only apply to the Built-in phase vocoder. Leave defaults unless you need more smoothness or lower latency.
voice_changer.toast_error_worker_panic: Voice changer stopped after an internal error. Start it again; if it keeps happening, report it. {{message}}
voice_changer.ep_fallback: {{requested}} is not available, so the voice model runs on {{active}}.
voice_changer.toast_ep_fallback: Voice changer: {{requested}} is not available, so it runs on {{active}}. Reason: {{reason}}
voice_changer.metrics_starting: Starting: opening devices and loading the model…
voice_changer.metrics_slow_warn: Conversion is slower than real time, so audio is being skipped. Pick a lighter profile or pitch extractor, a larger chunk size, or a GPU execution provider.
voice_changer.metrics_spikes_warn: Some blocks take longer than real time (p99), so expect an occasional skip. A larger chunk size, a lighter profile or the Protect voice priority helps.
voice_changer.metrics_dropping_warn: The voice changer is falling behind: audio older than the latency budget is skipped so your voice stays in time.
voice_changer.metrics_underrun_warn: Playback ran dry. Choose More delay under Playback feel, or raise the output prefill under Advanced.
voice_changer.latency_budget_info:
The most captured audio that may wait for conversion. When the voice changer falls behind (a GPU spike, a busy game), audio older than this is skipped instead of piling up, so your voice never drifts further and further behind.

Lower keeps the delay short but skips more under load; higher skips less but can add delay after a hiccup. 300 ms suits most PCs. Applies right away, in every mode (it is also how long Sigil waits for a WebSocket converter).
voice_changer.worker_priority_info:
How the voice changer shares the PC with your game and OBS.

Automatic: normal priority when the model runs on the GPU, lower priority when it runs on the CPU, so a CPU voice does not cost game frames.
Protect game FPS: always lower priority. The game wins; the voice may skip under heavy load.
Protect voice: normal priority and never throttled by Windows power saving. Fewer skips; the game may lose a few frames on a busy CPU.

Applies right away. Sigil never asks for administrator rights.
voice_changer.aux_mic_gate_info: Text-to-speech sent through the voice changer is mixed with your microphone before conversion. Lower the microphone turns it down by about 12 dB while TTS plays; Mute the microphone silences it so only the TTS voice is converted. Applies right away.
voice_changer.rvc_voices_empty: No voices in {{path}} yet. Put each voice in its own folder there (gen.onnx and an optional .index file) to pick it from a list, or choose any folder above.
voice_changer.rvc_slot_help:
A voice is a folder with gen.onnx (or model.onnx) and, optionally, the model's FAISS .index file (for example added_IVF256_Flat_nprobe_1.index) for Index rate. manifest.json is optional: without it Sigil infers the sample rate and features from the model, and warns if it has to guess. Voices in %AppData%/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/models/ appear in the Voice list.

Sigil keeps each voice's pitch, brightness, index rate, protect, pitch extractor and speaker ID in a slot.json file in its folder, so they come back when you pick the voice again.

Put shared HuBERT/ContentVec and FCPE under %AppData%/com.sigil.app/voice-changer/base/ (hubert_base.onnx, fcpe.onnx) or set paths below. First bring-up: Streamer + CPU + dio or fcpe; leave index at 0. Prefer 40 kHz exports. On 4-core PCs use OBS NVENC/QSV/AMF.
voice_changer.pitch_extractor_cpu_note: {{name}} needs a GPU execution provider. While RVC runs on the CPU, fcpe is used instead.
voice_changer.rvc_voice_consent_body: RVC makes you sound like the voice model you load. Only use voices whose owners agreed to it, and never use a converted voice to impersonate or deceive anyone.
voice_changer.rvc_voice_consent_ack: I will only use voices I have permission to use
voice_changer.toast_params_failed: Voice changer settings were not applied: {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_sidecar_connect: Voice changer (WebSocket): could not connect to the converter. {{message}}
voice_changer.toast_error_onnx_load: Voice changer (ONNX): the model could not be loaded. {{message}}

models.title: Models & Runtimes
models.intro: Speech models, voice templates and runtime packs that Sigil downloads. Every file is checked against the catalog before it is used, a cancelled download resumes where it stopped, and downloads run one at a time unless you allow two.
models.desktop_only: Models and runtimes are managed in the desktop app.
models.load_error: The model list could not be loaded: {{error}}
models.mirror_desc_auto: Tries each download's sources in order and moves to the next one when a source is blocked, broken or stalls.
models.mirror_desc_pref: Tries {{mirror}} first, then the other sources.
models.mirror_desc_custom: Tries your mirror first, as <mirror URL>/<model id>/<file>, then the usual sources. Files from any source are checked against the catalog.
models.url_problem_scheme: The address must start with https:// (or http:// for a server on your own network).
models.url_problem_invalid: This is not a valid web address.
models.url_problem_credentials: Remove the user name, password, query (?) or fragment (#) from the address.
models.url_problem_insecure: A mirror on the internet must use https://.
models.config_not_applied: Until this is fixed, downloads keep using the previous source.
models.config_error: The download settings were not applied: {{error}}
models.parallel_desc: One at a time is the gentlest on home routers. With two, Sigil still never downloads twice from the same server at once.
models.unpublished_hint: Not published for download yet: import the file you built or were given. A custom mirror can serve it only once the catalog pins its checksum.
models.adopted_hint: These files were already on this PC, so Sigil checked them instead of downloading them again.
models.verify_hint: Re-read every file and compare it with the catalog. A damaged install is removed so it can be downloaded again.
models.import_file_hint: Install from a file you already downloaded.
models.import_folder_hint: Install from a folder that holds all of its files.
models.import_folder_title: Choose the folder with the files for {{title}}
models.waiting: Waiting for the current download to finish.
models.req_low_disk: Only {{free}} is free on this drive.
models.req_unknown: This Sigil version does not know {{ids}}.

gpu.error: Could not read the hardware details: {{error}}
gpu.no_gpu: No graphics card was found, so models run on the processor.
gpu.vram_sigil: Sigil uses {{used}} of the {{budget}} Windows allows it
gpu.ep_code_unverified: Probably works, but Sigil could not check every requirement on this PC.
gpu.ep_code_software_only: Only the Microsoft Basic Render Driver is running. Install the graphics card driver.
gpu.ep_code_gpu_too_old: {{gpu}} is too old for this: it needs a {{min}} series card or newer.
gpu.ep_code_driver_too_old: NVIDIA driver {{driver}} is too old for this. Update to driver 580 or newer.
gpu.cuda_runtime_missing: CUDA also needs the NVIDIA GPU runtime download, which is not installed yet.
gpu.rec_hint: Based on your graphics card, the models Sigil has loaded and whether the voice changer is running. Suggestions update by themselves.
gpu.rec_reason_fits: Fits in the video memory Sigil can use ({{free}} available).
gpu.rec_reason_vc_running: The voice changer is running on the graphics card, so a lighter model keeps it responsive.
gpu.rec_reason_shared_gpu: Other models Sigil has loaded leave {{free}} of video memory, so a smaller model is used.
gpu.rec_reason_small_gpu: This graphics card has little video memory, so a smaller model is used.
gpu.rec_reason_no_gpu: No graphics card was found, so it runs on the processor.
gpu.rec_reason_integrated_gpu: The graphics card is built into the processor, so the model runs on the processor.
gpu.rec_reason_gpu_full: Only {{free}} of video memory is free for it right now, so it runs on the processor.
gpu.rec_reason_low_memory: This PC has little memory or few cores, so the smallest version is used.
gpu.gpu_probe_missing: The graphics driver did not answer, so Sigil could not read the graphics card details. Until a check succeeds, suggestions use the processor. Sigil checks again by itself, or press Check again.
gpu.gpu_probe_previous: The graphics driver did not answer the last check, so these details come from an earlier check.
gpu.ep_code_gpu_unknown: Could not be checked: the graphics driver did not answer.
gpu.rec_reason_no_gpu_runtime: Sigil has no GPU version of this model for this graphics card yet, so it runs on the processor.
gpu.rec_reason_gpu_unknown: The graphics card details could not be read, so it runs on the processor for now.
